notes: Copper (UTP Category 5) module, not optical. Data rate table lists 10–1,000 Mb/sec (IEEE 802.3). Symbol rate 250 Mbps on each of four pairs; line frequency 125 MHz (5-level encoding per IEEE 802.3). Power: 1.05 W typical (Features); supply table notes 1.2 W max over full voltage and temperature; caution states power consumption and surge current exceed SFP MSA. Electrical input described as +5 V ±5% with note that 3.3 V max is not allowed for continuous operation; Vcc table 3.13–3.47 V typ 3.3 V. Reach 100 m Category 5 UTP, BER <10^-12. RX_LOS optional per ordering; when not used tied to ground. Document titled/referenced for Fortinet; manufacturer brand not stated.
suggestions: Consider schema fields for copper media (Cat5/Cat5e), RJ-45, and electrical line rate (MHz) vs optical GBaud. post_fec_ber_target from cable BER note may need a distinct copper/Ethernet BER field.
